description: Generate an llms.txt file (https://llmstxt.org spec) from a sitemap. Parses sitemap.xml + nested indexes, groups URLs by top-level path, and emits a Markdown document with H1+description+sectioned link lists. Set fetch_titles=true to pull <title> per URL (slower, richer output).

fetch_titles.description: If true, fetch each URL to extract <title> for richer links. Slower (one HEAD-ish GET per URL). Default false uses the URL path as the link text.

limit.description: Max URLs to include. Truncated after sitemap parse, before title fetch.

site_description.description: One-paragraph site description placed under the H1. Optional but strongly recommended.

site_title.description: Site title - top H1 in the generated llms.txt file.

sitemap_url.description: URL of sitemap.xml (or sitemap index). Nested sitemaps are followed.

name: audit_llms_txt

content.description: Generated llms.txt file content; save to /llms.txt at site root.

sections.description: Number of top-level sections in the generated file.

titles_fetched.description: Number of pages fetched to extract <title>.

total_urls_in_sitemap.description: Total URLs found in the sitemap.

urls_included.description: URLs included after applying the limit.
